Title: AKU Faculty Receive ACGME-I's Award for Physician Leader and Physician Educator
NewsSummary: The award recognizes individuals who have played an integral role in pursuing excellence in their graduate medical education programs

content.text: Recognizing individuals who have played an integral role in pursuing excellence in their graduate medical education programs, Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education International (ACGME-I) recently announced the 2024 ACGME International Award recipients. Dr Rizwan Khan and Dr Novera Chughtai from AKU received the Physician Leader and Physician Educator award.

The Physician Leader award honors physicians who lead educational activities and promote values that underpin ACGME-I accreditation. The 2024 recipient Dr Rizwan Khan, Professor of Surgery, has served as the Associate Dean for postgraduate education at AKU since 2017. As the designated institutional official, he has provided dedicated leadership ultimately resulting in five residency programs achieving ACGME-I accreditation, including the first in Pakistan. Dr Khan is a renowned hepatobiliary surgeon, occupies the Kulsum Naurozali Rupsi Endowned Chair at his institution and is the Program Director for the surgical oncology fellowship program. He has more than 80 publications to his name.

The Physician Educator award honors program directors and faculty members directly involved with teaching residents and fellows and caring for patients. The 2024 recipient, Dr Novera Ghayoor Chughtai is an Assistant Professor and Program Director for Obstetrics and Gynecology at AKU. She has created and implemented a strong competency-based curriculum, as well as developed modules for LGBTQIA+ education and a breast surgery rotation for residents. She also promotes the pursuit of scholarship and research by her residents, especially in collaboration with faculty members. The ObGyn residency program at AKU achieved ACGME-I accreditation under her leadership and continues to enhance and internationally standardize education and training in obstetrics and gynecology.
Awardees will be honored during the 2024 ACGME Annual Educational Conference, taking place in March 2024 in Orlando, Florida, US.
